items.title: Edmond Hall Interview, 1958-07-18
items.q: you take a tune like Tiger, right?

ctx.x: Well it usually comes to you. Did you have quite a little time to get your fingers more fast? Yeah.

I mean they're going fast now, you take a tune like Tiger, right? They can't play too fast, the faster they play, I play high exercise, the faster they play, the better I like it. Oh yeah, the better I like it. And if you play it, and I got to play it fast, if somebody, if I'm playing it slow, it looks like it's a strain, you know? Yeah. I'm playing it fast, cause there's so many notes in it, if you miss them, you can't tell it to the good fast. You look finished. Good. Good.

Somebody once said, if you take a match, and go along real slow, and you can see the light flicker, and go along, and you go fast with the light, and you just look like one streak. That's right. Of course you run down and scale fast, and one road in there, it isn't there, it's too fast, your ear doesn't catch it. It's the same thing as ear doesn't. And then back to your lip again, if you do have any trouble with your lips, is there anything you can recommend, like certain ointments, or?
